failures.criterion: representative-phone, budgeted, independently reproducible CSS-vs-R3F performance evidence
failures.evidence: DECISION.md records unthrottled headless desktop Chromium and explicitly disclaims a physical phone, touch, mobile GPU, and device pixel ratio. It provides no concrete load, interaction, memory, or bundle pass thresholds. The temporary R3F source, measurement script, and raw JSON were removed, while the table reports ranges without retained per-run values/sample mapping.
failures.impact: The CSS decision remains plausible and all implementation checks pass, but §1 cannot prove representative-phone performance or that the chosen approach meets recorded performance/bundle budgets, and the reported comparison cannot be independently rerun.
failures.required_change: Recreate both spikes only long enough to declare explicit thresholds and rerun all required metrics on a documented representative phone environment; retain sanitized raw results plus sufficient non-production reproduction material; then remove the live R3F route/dependencies again and rerun tests, build, privacy, and cleanup checks.
failures.verification: An independent reviewer can rerun the retained procedure, see sample counts and pass/fail results for every threshold on the named phone profile, and confirm all R3F/temporary dependencies remain absent from the production package and build.
failures.refiner_response: Declared six explicit pass/fail thresholds (bundle, load, long tasks, frame stability, memory, interaction latency) in DECISION.md before measuring. Recreated both spikes (R3F source did not exist in git history — rebuilt from DECISION.md's own description) and measured 5 repetitions per route on Playwright's built-in 'Moto G4' device profile (the historical Lighthouse representative mid-tier phone) with CDP CPU 4x throttling and Slow-4G network throttling (150ms RTT, 1.6Mbps down, 750Kbps up). Found and fixed a methodology gap mid-pass: performance.memory quantized both used/total heap identically for both routes in this Chromium build, so memory was re-measured via CDP Performance.getMetrics instead, which produced real, distinguishing values. R3F fails the bundle threshold (232,976B vs 50KB budget); both routes fail the strict 0-long-tasks threshold under phone-class CPU throttling (a new finding invisible on unthrottled desktop), with R3F costing ~2.8x more main-thread blocking time than CSS. Retained sanitized raw per-run JSON (docs/phase10-spike-section-1/raw/phone-measurements.json), a non-executing copy of the measurement script (docs/phase10-spike-section-1/measure-phone.mjs), and a git-diff patch of the exact recreated R3F source (docs/phase10-spike-section-1/r3f-spike.patch) for independent reproduction. Removed the R3F route and ran `npm uninstall three @react-three/fiber @types/three playwright` again; confirmed package.json/package-lock.json byte-identical via `git diff --quiet` and all four packages absent from node_modules/npm ls. Did not recapture screenshots (visuals unchanged, per the acceptance handoff's explicit instruction). Did not begin §2.
